summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # **Petition No. 23/MP/2018** **Coram: Shri P.K. Pujari, Chairperson Dr. M.K. Iyer, Member Shri I.S.Jha, Member** **Date of Order: 2** **nd** **of April, 2019** # **In the matter of** Petition under Section 79(1) (c), Section 18 and Section 17(3) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and invoking all other enabling powers of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission permitting the amendment of the Transmission License dated 14.11.2014 granted to the NRSS XXIX Transmission Limited for establishing Transmission System for Northern Region System Strengthening Scheme NRSSXXIX. # **And In the matter of** NRSS XXIX Transmission Limited F-1, Mira Corporate Suits, 1 & 2, Mathura Road, Ishwar Nagar, New Delhi-110 065 Sterlite Grid 2 Limited F-1, Mira Corporate Suits, 1 & 2, Mathura Road, Ishwar Nagar, New Delhi-110 065 ** ..Petitioners** # **Vs.** NRSS XXIX (J) Transmission Limited F-1, Mira Corporate Suits, 1 & 2, Mathura Road, Ishwar Nagar, New Delhi-110 065 and others ** Respondents** # ** ORDER ** The Petitioners, NRSS XXIX Transmission Limited and Sterlite Grid 2 Limited jointly have filed the present Petition along with the following prayers: “(a) Permit transfer of JS Line in favour of a separate entity i.e Respondent No. 1 under Section 17 (3) of the Electricity Act, 2003; Order in Petition No. 23/MP/2018 Page 1 (b) Permit the amendment of Transmission Licence together with all related contractual documents, such that the Elements 2 to 4 is retained by the Petitioner No. 1 and the remaining Element i.e Element 1 or JS Line stand transferred to a separate entity i.e Respondent No. 1; (c) Grant in-Principle approval for a temporary licence for operating the JS Line till the time a new licence is issued for JS Line and for such interim period grant permission for continuation of tariff as per the Commission`s order dated 10.12.2014 in Petition No. 220/ADPT/2014; and (d) Pass necessary directions for signing of supplementary TSA.” 2. The Petitioners vide its letter dated 25.3.2019 have submitted that all the four elements of NRSS XXIX Transmission Limited, namely Jallandar-Samba (JS) line and Samba-Amargarh (SA) line along with GIS sub-station and LILO line have been commissioned on 26.6.2016 and 25.8.2018 respectively. Accordingly, the Petitioners have sought permission to withdraw the present Petition with liberty to file separate Petition. 3. The prayer of the Petitioners is allowed. However, prayer of the Petitioners for waiver of the filing fee of the Petition to be filed in future is rejected. 4. Accordingly, Petition No. 23/MP/2018 is disposed of as withdrawn. Sd/sd/sd/- **(I.S.Jha) (Dr. M.K. Iyer) (P.K. Pujari) Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 23/MP/2018 Page 2
